territories.name: Mongolia
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Mongolia levies a value added tax of its own under the Law on Value Added Tax of 9 July 2015: article 11 sets it at 10 per cent of the sale value of goods, work and services, article 12 zero-rates the supplies it lists, article 13 exempts the supplies it lists, and article 16 has the taxpayer file the return and pay by the 10th of the following month.
